name: CFBench
intro: CFBench是一个针对大型语言模型（LLMs）的综合性约束遵循基准测试。它旨在评估LLMs理解和遵循自然语言指令中复杂约束的能力，弥补了现有评估在约束全面性和真实性方面的不足。该基准包含1,000个精心策划的样本，涵盖200多个真实场景和50多个NLP任务，并提出了一个创新的约束类型系统框架和多维度评估方法。
build_method: 真实指令过滤聚类、LLM原子约束提取扩展、10大类25+子类体系、专业标注与专家质检
eval_feature: 独立检查点、主需/次需优先级、GPT-4o逐项判断、简单/困难分层
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2408.01122 and the official PKU-Baichuan CFBench repository and evaluation code. The diagram preserves online-log and NLP-task sourcing, filtering and clustering to about 30,000 representative instructions, LLM-assisted extraction and expansion to more than 5,000 unique atomic constraints, the 10-primary and 25-plus-subcategory taxonomy, assessment and balancing into 2,000 refined instructions, professional refinement of instructions and gold answers, independent checklist criteria with primary/secondary priority, training/cross-validation/batch validation and expert QC, the 1,000-sample release with 500 easy and 500 hard items across 200-plus scenarios, 20 domains, and 50-plus NLP tasks, 2,048-token model generation, GPT-4o checkpoint judging at temperature zero, and the executable CSR mean, ISR all-checkpoints-pass, and priority-aware PSR logic reported for easy, hard, and full sets.
build_method_en: Real-instruction Filtering and Clustering, LLM Atomic-constraint Extraction and Expansion, 10/25+ Taxonomy, Professional Annotation and Expert QC
eval_feature_en: Independent Checkpoints, Primary/Secondary Priority, GPT-4o Per-criterion Judging, Easy/Hard Stratification
intro_en: CFBench is a comprehensive constraint-following benchmark for large language models (LLMs). It aims to evaluate LLMs' ability to understand and adhere to complex constraints in natural language instructions, addressing the limitations of existing evaluations in constraint comprehensiveness and realism. The benchmark includes 1,000 carefully curated samples covering over 200 real-world scenarios and more than 50 NLP tasks, and introduces an innovative constraint type system framework along with a multidimensional evaluation approach.
